min_supported_version_code.description: Builds below this are hard-blocked when force_update_enabled is true

latest_version_code.description: Builds below this are offered a soft update (Play FLEXIBLE or a dismissible sheet)

force_update_enabled.description: Master switch for the hard update gate (Play IMMEDIATE update, else blocking screen)

in_app_update_enabled.description: Kill switch for the Play In-App Update API; false = gate screen / soft sheet only

soft_update_interval_days.description: Soft update prompt shows at most once per this many days per latest version

update_title.description: Optional update title override (empty = app string)

update_message.description: Optional update message override (empty = app string)

play_store_url.description: Store listing for Update/Rate/Share (empty = Play listing for the package)

maintenance_mode.description: Blocks the app with a maintenance screen

announcement_json.description: Banner JSON (object or array): id, title, body, cta, url (https) or route, style info|promo|success|warning, start, end, min_version, max_version, dismissible. Empty = none

support_email.description: Contact email shown in About (empty hides the row)

more_apps_url.description: Play developer page for More apps (https; empty hides the row)

config_version.description: Bump on every publish; reported to Crashlytics
